title: Establish the forensic standalone baseline
purpose: Import one selected standalone candidate without refactoring, reproduce its build from a clean checkout, and establish the exact source, test, artifact, and known-issue baseline from which architectural seams may later be introduced.

baseline.selectionRule: Populate only after the standalone candidate has passed its promotion gate.

invariants: No functional, UX, storage, identifier, or contract change is mixed with the import.
The source imported into GitHub is exactly the source selected as the standalone baseline.
The artifact is rebuilt from a clean checkout.
The tested artifact and the packaged artifact are identical.
Known defects and unproven claims remain explicitly recorded.
adversarialTests: mutate source after build and verify packaging fails
add an undeclared file and verify manifest validation fails
rebuild in a fresh environment and compare output
run all required browser and data-recovery tests against the rebuilt artifact
nonGoals: add accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, or tenancy
rollback: Delete the imported branch or revert the baseline import commit; the active standalone development source remains unchanged until the baseline is formally promoted.
